methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective cohort study with 149 TNBC patients divided by AR expression (IHC staining >1% cutoff). Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox regression appropriate for survival data. Univariate and multivariable analyses reported. Limitations: single-center, no external validation, modest sample size may lack power.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Individual case-control study examining prognostic marker in TNBC. Negative finding (AR not prognostic) useful but limited clinical impact without mechanistic insight. AR remains potential therapeutic target but prognostic role contradicted by meta-analyses.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods section describes IHC staining protocol, cutoff (>1%), and statistical analysis. Results present demographic characteristics and survival outcomes. Partial REMARK adherence. Missing elements: reporting guidelines checklist, sensitivity analysis for cutoff choices, data availability statement.

novelty_literature.justification: Confirms negative findings from meta-analysis (AR expression not prognostic in TNBC). Authors position as first in Levant region but confirms known lack of association. Limited incremental knowledge; addresses controversy but non-confirmatory direction weakens novelty.

writing_presentation.justification: Clear Methods and Results sections. Discussion appropriately contextualizes contradictory findings in literature. Organization adequate. Some sections could be tightened. Figures 1-2 clearly present Kaplan-Meier curves.

key_strengths: Addresses clinical controversy regarding AR prognostic role in TNBC with multivariate analysis controlling for confounders
Adequate follow-up duration (median 61.6 months) for mature survival assessment
Consistent negative findings across OS, DFS, and BCSS endpoints
key_concerns: Limited sample size (149 patients) may lack power to detect moderate effect sizes given AR expression rate 36.7%
Single-center cohort from specialized cancer center may not represent general TNBC population
Lack of external validation; findings could be site-specific artifact
Limited novelty: confirms meta-analysis findings rather than resolving controversy
chief_reviewer.rationale: Competently executed retrospective study confirming AR is not prognostic in TNBC, consistent with recent meta-analyses. Methodological rigor adequate for case series but limited novelty. Sample size and single-center design preclude strong inference. Tier 4 appropriate for incremental negative result.
